what_it_does: This paper addresses real-time respiratory rate monitoring using millimeter-wave radar (mmWave), a non-invasive sensing technology that works through clothing and in poor lighting. The challenge is implementing the signal processing pipeline efficiently on an embedded system-on-chip (using the PYNQ platform, which is programmable FPGA fabric coupled with ARM processors). The paper implements a complete pipeline: frequency analysis of ranging signals, phase extraction and unwrapping to resolve ambiguities, filtering, and multiple respiratory rate estimation techniques combined optimally to improve accuracy.
